effects: The signer sends `assets` WETH to the vault (safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), assets)) and spends the same amount of their WETH allowance to the vault.
The vault mints previewDeposit(assets) gWETHq shares to `onBehalf`; the share count comes from the share price in storage, and there is no minimum.
formats.shown: Deposit 0.05 WETH for the onBehalf address, with a constant 'Share ticker gWETHq' line and 'Send shares to' naming the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many gWETHq shares are minted; the vault's share price sets the number.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets); enter(assets, shares, onBehalf);`. The calldata has no shares or minimum-shares parameter. The descriptor field 'Share ticker' is the raw constant `$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker` and has no amount.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. ERC-4626 deposit has no minimum-shares input.

findings.title: deposit shows a constant 'Share ticker' line with no amount, which adds a line but no fact.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit field: {"label": "Share ticker", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"}; case 0 screen shows 'Share ticker: gWETHq'.
findings.fix: Remove the field, or fold the ticker into the label of `onBehalf`, e.g. "Send gWETHq shares to".

cases.notes: Signer sends 0.05 WETH (shown). Shares go to 0xdEaD, not the signer (signer null); the screen shows this in 'Send shares to' and the reader saw it.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns previewWithdraw(assets) gWETHq shares from `onBehalf` (the signer in the test); the share count comes from the share price in storage, and there is no maximum.
When msg.sender != onBehalf, the call spends the signer's share allowance from onBehalf by the burned share count.
The vault sends exactly `assets` WETH to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly 100 WETH to the receiver, with the Owner of the shares shown; the burned share count is not shown.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many gWETHq shares the owner burns; the share price sets the number.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);` and exit: `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares);`. Case 1: signer sends 99.851482821259799306 gWETHq to 0x0 (signer out); the screen shows only 'Withdraw exactly 100 WETH'.
findings.fix: None for the amount: the calldata has no maximum-shares parameter. Optionally change the intent to "Withdraw WETH from gWETHq vault" so the signer knows shares are burned.

findings.title: withdraw labels onBehalf 'Owner' without saying the owner's gWETHq shares are burned.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw field: {"path": "onBehalf", "label": "Owner"}; VaultV2.sol exit: `deleteShares(onBehalf, shares);`. The case 1 reader wrote 'screen doesn't show shares'.
findings.fix: Change the label to "Burn gWETHq shares from".

cases.notes: WETH in: exactly 100 WETH to the signer (shown right). gWETHq out: 99.85 shares burned from the signer; no amount or share asset on the screen. The reader guessed shares were burned but did not know how many.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` gWETHq from `onBehalf` (the signer in the test).
When msg.sender != onBehalf, the call spends the signer's share allowance from onBehalf by `shares`.
The vault sends previewRedeem(shares) WETH to `receiver`; the amount comes from the share price in storage, and there is no minimum.
formats.shown: Redeem 0.005092552216080191 gWETHq to the receiver, with the Owner shown; nothing names WETH as the asset received or its amount.

findings.title: redeem never names WETH as the asset the receiver gets, although the descriptor has the constant.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);` with asset = WETH (immutable 0xc02a…6cc2). The descriptor defines `underlyingToken` and `underlyingTicker` but the redeem format uses neither. Case 2: signer receives 0.005101229077275041 WETH (signer in); the screen fields are 'Shares to redeem', 'To', 'Owner'. The reader wrote 'Which token is paid out; screen doesn't say'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Redeem gWETHq for WETH" and the interpolatedIntent to "Redeem {#.shares} for WETH to {#.receiver}".

findings.title: redeem cannot show how much WETH the receiver gets; the share price sets the amount.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares); exit(assets, shares, receiver, onBehalf);`. The calldata has no minimum-assets parameter.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor for the amount.

cases.notes: gWETHq out: 0.005092552216080191 shares (shown right). WETH in: 0.005101229077275041 WETH to the signer; neither the asset nor the amount is on the screen. The reader guessed 'probably WETH' with an unknown amount.
